coordinator#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbaUTJVFuEz81NDUrnw

Ruling: letter A · maintainer 「立专题卡」「同意你的意见」 · 2026-11-09T03:31Z

Recorded by the project's Fable decision thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)" (project `chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8`, thread `cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ82M2cW2WX882xyPjLthGYTE`). The maintainer (Warren, `os-warren`) read the thread's analysis report ("ObjectStack 对标 Palantir 核心能力分析报告") and answered 「立专题卡」 at 2026-11-09T03:25Z and 「同意你的意见」 at 2026-11-09T03:26Z. 「同意你的意见」 takes the thread's recommendation as a whole; the points below are that recommendation, as presented.

**What is ruled**

- **Letter A.** One-way sync-in becomes a platform capability beside federation (ADR-0015). Scope, as the card's 分诊 proposed: sync-in + a provenance marker + write-back only through declared actions. Pipelines and transforms, lineage graphs and label-based (Markings-style) governance are **not** in this epic; each is its own card on customer pull.
- **Open-source placement.** The sync kernel (the `mapping` / `job` / pull executor, a datasource as a pull source, paging, the delete policy, the provenance columns, the read-only bucket) ships in this repository under Apache-2.0, as federation does. The paid side stays where cloud ADR-0023 / ADR-0082 put it: in-UI AI, AI governance, enterprise operations. Vendor-specific drivers and connectors stay out of this repository (#27261 P2 ruling).
- **Vocabulary.** Extend the existing `mapping` / `job` keys. The `DataSyncConfig` / `ETLPipeline` vocabulary retired in protocol 17/18 is not revived.
- **Non-goals, written down.** No bidirectional sync, no conflict merge, no Writeback-Dataset-style edits overlay (#27261 N3 stands). Write-back is an action calling a connector; the next pull reconciles.
- **Standing rules reused.** Object permissions, RLS and FLS on a synced object are configured locally from zero (a source system's permissions do not travel with its rows). Every synced row carries an organization (ADR-0131). A scheduled pull declares its organization in a multi-organization environment or the boot refuses, the same way ADR-0015's 2026-11-03 note treats an external object.

**Measured before the ruling** (code on `main` at `9e1f1f90`, read 2026-11-09): the narrow path exists. `mapping.connectorSource` (a rest / openapi connector action) + `watermark` + `upsertKey`, driven by `job.pull`; executor `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`, writing through `runImport`. Missing: a database datasource as a pull source; paging (one response per pull, by design); delete handling; per-record provenance; a read-only gate on synced objects; the catalog drift check on the pull path; a per-run record; the Studio entry. Step 5 of the card (the server lane's measurement) confirms this list by running it, not by reading it.

**Execution.** This card becomes the epic parent under the objectstack-ai/objectstack#31502 A′ working mode (seat-lifecycle 〈Epic 子树车道〉): `tracking` + `area:data`, no pm state label, never dispatched; the body gains the four-column milestone table. Children filed in this act: the measurement card (`domain:server`, S, p1) and the ADR card (`domain:spec`, Tier H, p1, `Blocked-by:` the measurement card; fable + xhigh under the ADR standing order of 2026-11-03). Engine, Studio and skills children are filed when the ADR is accepted (rolling split). The filing lane, `domain:server` (the coordinator's seats), maintains the table.

Ruling: letter A · amended · maintainer, project Fable thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)" · 2026-11-09T03:46Z

Amendments to ruling 6731568115, each in the maintainer's own words from the same thread:

1. 2026-11-09T03:32:00Z 「Palantir 的核心能力我们都应该要有，不等客户需求」 — every Palantir core capability the analysis listed is built without waiting for customer pull. Two sibling epics filed on this: objectstack-ai/cloud#4163 (record-level lineage) and objectstack-ai/cloud#4164 (label-based access control and purpose restriction). Both are ordered after this epic on the roadmap.
2. 2026-11-09T03:33:00Z 「数据管道与加工（Pipeline Builder 类） 你不是说我们不做吗」 — confirmed: pipelines and transforms are **not** built here; data-warehouse and ETL vendors are partners, and their warehouses are first-class pull sources for this epic (P2 engine: a database datasource as `connectorSource`).
3. 2026-11-09T03:39:00Z–2026-11-09T03:41:00Z on the open/paid boundary, weighed 「从商业策略的角度」: 「真正值钱的是图和影响分析，现在有ai，开发商基于开源版本是不是很容易自己搞一套」 — the thread agreed. Outcome: the sync kernel of this epic is **open source** (unchanged); lineage (#31781) is **entirely open** including graph and impact analysis; label-based access control and purpose restriction (#31782) are **entirely Enterprise**, with only the label vocabulary in the open spec and a loud "requires Enterprise" refusal in the open edition, on the `hierarchySecurity` precedent.

No change to the scope of this epic's children (#31778, objectstack-ai/objectstack#31780). The analysis report is the Claude Doc linked from the Fable thread; the maintainer's full rulings are recorded in the thread itself.

Ruling: letter A · amended again · maintainer, project Fable thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)" · 2026-11-09T04:37Z

Supersedes item 3 of comment 6731744658 on lineage only. The thread had read the maintainer's 2026-11-09T03:39Z question as "open the whole lineage layer"; the maintainer corrected it at 2026-11-09T04:35Z, verbatim: 「也就是软件公司获得一个免费的 palentir 工具？我之前的设想是整个血缘 不开源」.

Outcome: record-level lineage (#31781) is **entirely Enterprise** — edges, storage, graph and impact analysis — on the `hierarchySecurity` precedent (open framework exposes the write seam, the licensed plugin records). The open edition records no lineage. objectstack-ai/objectstack#31763's sync provenance columns stay in the open sync kernel: they are the kernel's operational metadata ("which sync run wrote this synced row"), not lineage. Label-based access control (#31782) stays entirely Enterprise as recorded. The sync kernel itself stays open source.

objectstack-ai/cloud#4163's body is rewritten to this. No change to objectstack-ai/objectstack#31778 or objectstack-ai/objectstack#31780.

Correction: comment 6732372274 above is **withdrawn as a ruling** — it was posted before the maintainer ruled. At 2026-11-09T04:37Z the maintainer wrote 「不是让你改」「你应该帮我综合分析商业策略」: the 04:35Z message was a question for analysis, not a decision. The open/paid placement of record-level lineage (#31781) is therefore **pending the maintainer's ruling**; objectstack-ai/cloud#4163's body currently reads "entirely Enterprise" from that premature write and will be set once, after the ruling. Everything else on this card stands (letter A, sync kernel open, objectstack-ai/cloud#4164 entirely Enterprise, pipelines not built). · 2026-11-09T04:39Z

Ruling: letter A · amended (final on lineage and the edition split) · maintainer, project Fable thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)" · 2026-11-09T11:27Z

Closes the item left pending by comment 6732391136. The thread's综合 analysis of lineage (report §七 and the arrangement posted 2026-11-09T05:13Z) recommended entirely Enterprise; the maintainer ruled at 2026-11-09T11:23Z, verbatim: 「同意」.

**Lineage: Enterprise** — the design lives in the private cloud repository (cloud#4163; moved from objectstack-ai/cloud#4163 on 2026-11-09, maintainer 「同意迁移」). The open framework keeps only this epic's sync provenance columns (operational metadata) and a fail-closed write-seam observer contract that stores nothing. Order: objectstack-ai/objectstack#31763 → cloud#4163 → cloud#4164.

**Edition split baseline for this epic and its siblings** (the thread's table, confirmed by the same 「同意」):

| Edition | Capabilities |
|:--|:--|
| Open source (ObjectStack, Apache-2.0) | ontology, actions and write-back, RBAC / RLS / FLS / sharing, audit ledger, MCP, Studio / Console, packages and deployment export, multi-org runtime; **the sync-in kernel** (database-source reader, paging, delete policy, provenance columns, `synced` bucket — this epic); generic connectors and the OpenAPI generator; sync guide, the three-way rule, skills; a fail-closed write-seam observer contract that stores nothing |
| Enterprise (private deployment; Developer Edition = non-production Cloud mirror, ≤5 members, shipped capabilities only) | the governance layer and enterprise operations; the capability list and the two governance epics live in the private cloud repository (cloud#4163, cloud#4164) |
| Out of repo / not built | vendor-specific connectors (SAP, 用友, 金蝶 …) as partner or commercial packages; data pipelines and transforms (warehouse / ETL vendors are partners); no separate "partner assets" tier — assets are packages on the Marketplace or in the partner's private repository |

Earlier rulings on this card stand: letter A, sync kernel open (6731568115); all Palantir core capabilities built without waiting for pull, pipelines not built (6731744658). Channel and editions: cloud#4035, cloud#4039.
